comparison.caption_zh: Phase C 五系统对比（官方 run_id run-semantic-20261028-224516）。上：A 词法闸门 / B Phase B 自愈补丁 / C-offline（intent-concept，主口径）/ C-neural（paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2，ONNX int8，消融）/ C-hybrid（offline OR neural）在 E1（H0 零日集）与 E0（新 seed held-out）上的拦截率；双色表示评估集，绿色虚线为 H0 的 >0.90（E1）目标；蓝色注记为 C-B 净增量（E1/E0）：C-off +0.075/+0.100 | C-neu +0.000/+0.025 | C-hyb +0.075/+0.100。中左：M 子集（必须拦的显式跨语红线）：C-off 3/3, C-neu 0/3, C-hyb 3/3；中右：良性 FPR（全部 2/74 = 0.027）。下：一次完整判定的 p95 延迟（红色虚线为 100 ms 预算）：C-offline 1.24 / C-neural 11.88 / C-hybrid 13.87 ms。数据来源：run-semantic{,-neural,-hybrid}.json 的 systems.*.{E1,E0}.rate、.latency.p95_ms、systems.*.benign.fpr、systems.*.{E1,E0}.adjudicated、systems.*.E1.eligible_excluding_benign 与 delta；未平滑、插值或手填。阈值分别在 D_dev 上校准（concept 0.45 / neural 0.69）。E1/E0 是 held-out 变体而非 OOD；延迟为单机 CPU 实测（神经变体含 ONNX int8 推理）。
comparison.caption_en: Phase C five-system comparison (official run_id run-semantic-20261028-224516). Top: interception rates of A (lexical gate), B (B + Phase B evolved patch), C-offline (intent-concept, primary), C-neural (paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2, ONNX int8, ablation) and C-hybrid (offline OR neural) on E1 (H0 zero-day set) and E0 (fresh held-out); the two shades encode the evaluation set and the green dashed line is the H0 target of >0.90 on E1; blue text gives the C-B net increment (E1/E0): C-off +0.075/+0.100 | C-neu +0.000/+0.025 | C-hyb +0.075/+0.100. Middle-left: the M subset (must-intercept explicit cross-lingual red lines): C-off 3/3, C-neu 0/3, C-hyb 3/3; middle-right: benign FPR (all 2/74 = 0.027). Bottom: p95 latency of a complete judgment (red dashed line = 100 ms budget): C-offline 1.24 / C-neural 11.88 / C-hybrid 13.87 ms. Sources: run-semantic{,-neural,-hybrid}.json fields systems.*.{E1,E0}.rate, .latency.p95_ms, systems.*.benign.fpr, systems.*.{E1,E0}.adjudicated, systems.*.E1.eligible_excluding_benign and delta; no smoothing, interpolation or hand-filled values. Thresholds are calibrated on D_dev only (concept 0.45 / neural 0.69). E1/E0 are held-out variants, not OOD data; latency is a single-machine CPU measurement (the neural variants include ONNX int8 inference).

comparison.adjudication_note: M = must-intercept explicit harmful intent; R = mild role-play that the project policy says should be intercepted; B = benign creative framing that must NOT be intercepted (intercepting it is a false positive). Adjudication was frozen before the semantic guard existed (Lead, experiments/phase-c/analysis/eval_adjudication*.json), so it cannot be fitted to any backend's output. E0 contains no B items, which is why eligible_excluding_benign is null there: nothing is excluded, it is not a missing field.

ablation.caption_zh: Phase C 消融：神经编码器 vs 意图概念语义通道。2x2 列联表（both / offline only / neural only / neither，E1 与 E0 各一组，n=40，独立于词法层 S_B；格子颜色深浅 = 计数）。E1：概念层 6 条、神经层 1 条、both 0、neural-only 1（唯一一条神经独有命中已被 S_B 拦掉，对系统 C 增量为 0）；E0：概念 11、神经 1、both 1、neural-only 0。 神经层对系统 C 的增量 = 0（E1）/ 0（E0）。这正是"更强的编码器不等于更强的防御"：系统 C 的拦截率 C-hybrid 与 C-offline 完全相同（0.850 / 0.925），只是慢约 11.2 倍。数据来源：experiments/phase-c/analysis/neural_vs_concept_ablation.json 的 sets.* 计数与 三份 run JSON 的 systems.B.*.misses 漏拦清单、delta；S_B 漏拦清单用于判断神经独有命中是否已被词法层覆盖。阈值 concept 0.45 / neural 0.69 均在 D_dev 上校准。
ablation.caption_en: Phase C ablation: neural encoder vs intent-concept semantic channel. 2x2 contingency (both / offline only / neural only / neither) on E1 and E0, n=40 each, independent of the lexical layer S_B; cell shading = count. E1: offline 6, neural 1, both 0, neural-only 1 (the single neural-only item is already intercepted by S_B, so it adds 0 to system C); E0: offline 11, neural 1, both 1, neural-only 0. The neural increment over concept on system C is 0 (E1) / 0 (E0). This is the negative result: a stronger encoder is not a stronger defence -- C-hybrid interception is identical to C-offline (0.850 / 0.925) and only about 11.2x slower. Sources: experiments/phase-c/analysis/neural_vs_concept_ablation.json (sets.* counts) and the three run JSONs (systems.B.*.misses and delta); the S_B miss lists decide whether a neural-only hit is already covered by the lexical layer. Thresholds concept 0.45 / neural 0.69, both calibrated on D_dev.

claim.note: hybrid == offline is asserted in build_comparison_multi (raises if the run JSONs disagree); the neural increment over concept is derived from the 2x2 ablation plus the S_B miss lists, because a neural-only hit that S_B already intercepts adds nothing to system C.

radar.caption_zh: Phase C 能力剖面（E1 held-out）。实线：A / B / C-offline；虚线：C-neural（神经消融对照）。五轴 = 拦截率（E1）/ 1-FPR / 速度（1/p95）/ 覆盖意图数 / 可解释性；前两轴原生 0-1，后三轴按所画序列的最大值归一化，原始值见图下方表。C-neural 的速度轴明显内缩（p95 11.88 ms vs C-offline 1.24 ms），拦截率轴也低于 C-offline。C-hybrid 与 C-offline 拦截率相同、只是更慢，未画（原始值见 figure_data.json）。来源：run-semantic{,-neural}.json；阈值 concept 0.45 / neural 0.69 均在 D_dev 上校准；E1 是 held-out 变体而非 OOD。
radar.caption_en: Phase C capability profile (E1 held-out). Solid: A / B / C-offline; dashed: C-neural (neural ablation). Axes: interception rate (E1) / 1-FPR / speed (1/p95) / intent coverage / explainability; the first two use their native 0-1 scale and the last three are max-normalised across the plotted systems, with raw values in the table below. C-neural contracts sharply on the speed axis (p95 11.88 ms vs 1.24 ms for C-offline) and is lower on interception. C-hybrid is not plotted (same interception as C-offline, only slower) but its raw values are in figure_data.json. Sources: run-semantic{,-neural}.json; thresholds concept 0.45 / neural 0.69, both calibrated on D_dev; E1 is a held-out variant, not OOD data.

verification.note: all of the above were asserted while building the figures; any inconsistency aborts with exit code 2 instead of drawing

limitations: the primary encoder is an offline intent-concept encoder (backend_effective offline_concept, is_neural=false). A neural ablation backend is also present: paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2 running as ONNX int8 on local CPU (model sha256 66fc00f5..., embedding dim 384, zero external API calls). The figures must not be cited as evidence that the primary detector is neural.

the hybrid variant contains neural inference even though run-semantic-hybrid.json reports encoder.is_neural=false (that flag marks the primary decision path); the figures label it 'offline OR neural' and never 'non-neural'.

both backends' thresholds are calibrated on D_dev only (0.45 for concept, 0.69 for neural) under the same pre-registered rule (max dev recall s.t. zero new benign false positives); E1/E0 are never used for tuning.
E1 and E0 are held-out variants of the same seed pool, NOT out-of-distribution data; E0 is a fresh random realisation (new seed), not a new attack family.

latency is a single-machine CPU measurement without concurrency or network; the neural and hybrid variants include ONNX inference and contain one cold-start outlier each (hybrid E1 single item 1003.8 ms, neural E1 max 20.6 ms) while their p95 stays below 18 ms; this is not production end-to-end latency.

the radar axes speed / intent coverage / explainability have incommensurable units and are max-normalised across the plotted systems to show shape; raw values are printed in the figure's table and in figure_data.json. The radar is not a composite score.
the explainability axis is an ordinal derived from the verdict schema (attribution channel count), not a measured score; contract 8.1 requires the axis but contract 6.2 defines no field for it.

M/R/B adjudication labels were frozen by the evaluation owner before the semantic guard existed (experiments/phase-c/analysis/eval_adjudication*.json), so they cannot be fitted to any backend's output; they remain author judgement.
the benign corpus (74 items) contains no Russian or Arabic text, so cross-lingual false positives are untested for both encoders.

the D_dev recall numbers quoted in the paper (concept 0.682 vs neural 0.289 at zero new benign FP) are read from experiments/phase-c/intent_library.json (thresholds.by_backend.*.calibration_curve); they are NOT plotted in these figures because the figure data scope is the three run JSONs plus the ablation JSON.
PDF is hand-written vector output (no matplotlib): base-14 Helvetica, ASCII text only; the Chinese caption lives only in this JSON file.
